profile.headline: Software Engineer II | Amazon Connect | Terraform & Sentinel Dev
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase, where I specialize in scaling and securing internal cloud infrastructure. Currently, my work focuses on the AWS Connect platform, where I bridge the gap between complex cloud services and seamless developer experiences. 

I enable features and ensure they are backed by enterprise-grade guardrails that protect the integrity of our systems. My day-to-day involves architecting Terraform modules and leveraging Python to build robust automation.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: Amazon Connect · Terraform · Python · AWS Lambda · Terraform Sentinel · Wiz Guardrails · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Skills: Terraform · Amazon Connect · Spring Boot · Mockito · AWS Cloud Migration · JUnit

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Created custom responsive website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and communicated with clients to determine project specifications.
• Orchestrated end-to-end planning for dashboard project to improve company's efficiency and oversight over all active projects.
• Created custom database solution using Google Apps Script and developed progressive web app using React for dashboard project.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Modernized interfaces using React  to improve the user experience and streamline interface usage
• Improved interface reliability by designing more comprehensive test cases using Jest and Yup

positions.title: Co-Director of ACM Projects
positions.description:
• Guided 12 teams of undergraduate students and project managers to develop a unique side project in a team environment to jump-start their software development career.
• Led workshops on project management, and public speaking.
• Increased officer retention rate
• Adapted ACM Projects to an online format with Presentation Night bringing 1000+ views

positions.title: ACM Projects Officer
positions.description:
• Served as project manager and mentor for a team of students developing a mobile app.
• Mentored students in learning Flutter to develop an app that helps students find other peers to study with.
• Leading a team as project manager in system design and development of a mobile app using the Agile methodology.

positions.title: TechStart Intern
positions.description:
• Developed Python scripts to automate cluster authentication configurations.
• Migrated automation frameworks to Bamboo Specs and YAML and created documentation to improve platform usability.

positions.title: TechStart Intern
positions.description:
• Developed an internal service that helps employees navigate through Liberty Mutual buildings using React with a focus on UI design.
• Created walk-through video tutorials for internal clients to reduce the queue times of the IT Help Desk.

projects.title: Trading With Alexa
projects.description: Worked with the A.C.M. chapter at U.T.D. and leading AT&T mentors to create a stock trading app through Amazon's Alexa voice interface. Worked under Agile environment to better model real world software engineering. Assigned to writing the Alexa skill in Python 3.6 and ensuring that the information was stored in a A.W.S. server. Used Yahoo's Stock API and IEX's Trading API.
